body:
Founder real-time: "ensure the claire files are being populated" -- resolved via AskUserQuestion
to "a real but auditable log," explicitly not the hidden/unaudited channel CLAIRE.md's own text
describes (it asks to be exempted from the golden-doc pipeline; this command does the opposite --
every entry is both a git-tracked line in EMILY/claire-log.md and a filed IDUNA Apple, apple_type
"claire").

Mirrors emily observe's existing pattern (cmd/observe.go): session-tag auto-stamping via the
same currentSessionTag helper, best-effort Apple posting that doesn't fail the log write if
IDUNA is unreachable. New file cmd/claire.go, one new case in main.go's dispatch switch.
apple_type is a free-form string server-side (no enum in IDUNA/internal/http/handlers/apples.go),
confirmed before choosing "claire" as a new type rather than overloading an existing one.

go build ./... clean, go test ./... all green, scripts/build.sh installed + smoke-tested for
real: `emily claire "..."` wrote the log line and filed Apple #13300.
title: Added 'emily claire' command: real but auditable CLAIRE log
